messages:
Rina: FYI platform team approved server-side batching kickoff. They want SDKs to stop exposing `batch_size`/`batch_window` after a deprecation period. Proposing 6mo window + shim headers. Thoughts?

Carlos: Generally +1. Central batching should reduce tokens wasted and smooth utilization. Concern: latency-sensitive clients. Need opt-out.

Miki: UX: console must surface per-tenant toggle and a timeline of when their requests switched to platform batching. Also we need a small experiment UI for canary tenants.

DevOpsBot: Canary job scheduled: rollout-platform-batching -> 2025-02-15T09:00Z (10% tenants).

Sam: Suggest header formats: `x-rw-client-batching: legacy|shim|none` and `x-rw-batch-hint: v1;size=8;window_ms=20`. Keep parsing strict.

Yara: Telemetry plan: 30d 100% capture for legacy-header flows, then downsample to 5%. Emit event `client_batching_flag` with sdk, sdk_version, tenant_id, route, hint, latency_ms, tokens.

Rina: SDK plan: patch releases add header + startup warning; add opt-in flag in minor; major removes fields. Add a migration CLI to scan repos for `batch_size` usage.

Carlos: Add unit + e2e check to ensure legacy header present during canary. Also add console metric counting tenants still sending legacy header.

Miki: Banner copy draft: "Switch to Platform-managed batching (recommended). Centralized batching improves cost and throughput. Keep per-client batching only if you require strict single-request latency." CTA -> migration KB.

Sam: Quick shim example (Go):

```go
// legacy
client := redwood.NewClient(redwood.Config{BatchSize: 8, BatchWindowMs: 20})
// shim sends header
req.Header.Set("x-rw-client-batching", "legacy")
req.Header.Set("x-rw-batch-hint", "v1;size=8;window_ms=20")
```

Yara: I'll own the telemetry PR and sampling rules.

Rina: I'll draft the migration KB + CLI. Carlos + Sam: take SDK shims. Miki: take banner + canary UX.

Carlos: Will add CI smoke tests.

Rina: Link to WIP doc: https://redwood-internal.example/docs/centralized-batching (WIP). Thanks all :thumbsup:
